# Published S2 fixture

Own-content fixture frozen from commit `729a2c979f1cfca222c390b309dd943cdf5b3347` before renderer changes. Contains nested ordered/unordered lists, code, inline/display math, repeated paragraphs with distinct IDs, a small image, and partial mock translation. `reader.zip` is immutable; tests read it directly and never rebuild it. `frozen.json` records the original UUID, archive bytes/hash and every member identity.
